decisions.label: Fade at the foot (m)
decisions.note: How far from its trunk's foot a shadow fades in from nothing (0: none).

decisions.label: Taper at the foot (m)
decisions.note: How far from its foot a shadow opens out from a third of its width, so wide roots don't splay (0: none).

decisions.label: Fade near her (m)
decisions.note: A trunk's shadow fades to nothing as she comes within this distance of the trunk (0: never).

decisions.label: Darkens grass and flowers
decisions.note: How much a shadow darkens the grass, flowers and tufts it falls on (1: as much as the ground; 0: not at all).
